description_en: Modifies the employee information maintained in Alibaba Business Travel, such as the employee name, mobile phone number, and gender
description_zh: 通过调用本接口可以修改已维护在阿里商旅中的员工信息，如员工姓名、手机号、性别等
name: UpdateEmployee

parameters.help_en: The employee ID. This is the unique identifier of the employee within the enterprise. Make sure that the ID is unique
parameters.help_zh: 员工 ID，是员工在企业内的唯一标识，请确保唯一性
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en: The nickname of the employee
parameters.help_zh: 员工昵称
parameters.name: user_nick

parameters.help_en: The name of the employee
parameters.help_zh: 员工姓名
parameters.name: real_name

parameters.help_en:
The English name of the employee. Specify the value in the following format:
Separate the last name and the first name with a forward slash (/). Example: LastName/FirstName.
Do not leave spaces between the last name and the first name
parameters.help_zh:
员工英文名。请按照以下格式要求进行传值：
英文姓氏与名字间用 "/" 分隔，如：LastName/FirstName。
姓氏与名字之间不要留有空格
parameters.name: real_name_en

parameters.help_en: The avatar of the employee. Specify the URL of the image
parameters.help_zh: 员工头像，请传入图片的 URL 地址
parameters.name: avatar

parameters.help_en: The gender of the employee
parameters.help_zh: 员工性别
parameters.name: gender

parameters.help_en:
The birthday of the employee.
Format: `yy-MM-dd`
parameters.help_zh:
员工生日。
格式要求：`yy-MM-dd`
parameters.name: birthday

parameters.help_en: The list of departments to which the employee belongs
parameters.help_zh: 员工任职（归属）部门列表
parameters.name: out_dept_id_list

parameters.help_en: The job level of the employee. This is typically used to match different travel standards
parameters.help_zh: 员工的职级，通常用来匹配不同的差旅标准
parameters.name: position_level

parameters.help_en: The employee number. This and `user_id` serve as the unique identifiers of the employee. Make sure that the value is unique
parameters.help_zh: 员工的工号，与`user_id`同为该员工的唯一标识。请确保传入参数的唯一性
parameters.name: job_no

parameters.help_en: The email address of the employee
parameters.help_zh: 员工邮箱
parameters.name: email

parameters.help_en:
The mobile phone number of the employee.
This is typically used to process business travel category bookings and is required in this case.
If your enterprise is a government agency or other special enterprise, call 400-800-5890 to contact an Alibaba Business Travel customer service representative first
parameters.help_zh:
员工手机号。
通常用于处理商旅类目预定的业务，此时为必填项。
若您的企业性质为政府机关或其他特殊企业，请先拨打 400-800-5890 与阿里商旅客服人员联系
parameters.name: phone

parameters.help_en: The ID of the direct manager of the employee
parameters.help_zh: 员工直属主管 ID
parameters.name: manager_user_id

parameters.help_en:
The 6-digit administrative code of the work location.
You can specify up to two different administrative codes
parameters.help_zh:
工作地 6 位行政编码。
最多传入两个不同的行政编码
parameters.name: base_city_code_list

fields.help_en:
The birthday of the employee.
Format: `yy-MM-dd`
fields.help_zh:
员工生日。
格式要求：yy-MM-dd
fields.name: birthday

fields.help_en:
The expiration date of the identity document.
Format: `yy-MM-dd`
fields.help_zh:
证件有效期。
格式要求：`yy-MM-dd`
fields.name: cert_expired_time

fields.help_en: The 2-letter country code of the country or region that issued the identity document
fields.help_zh: 证件签发国家/地区二字码（Country Code）
fields.name: cert_nation

fields.help_en: The number of the identity document
fields.name: cert_no

fields.help_en: The type of the identity document
fields.name: cert_type

fields.help_en: The gender of the employee. The gender must be consistent with the identity document information
fields.help_zh: 员工性别，需与证件信息保持一致
fields.name: gender

fields.help_en: The 2-letter country code of the country or region to which the employee belongs
fields.help_zh: 员工所属国家/地区二字码（Country Code）
fields.name: nationality

fields.help_en: The mobile phone number of the employee
fields.name: phone

fields.help_en: The name of the employee. The name must be consistent with the identity document information
fields.help_zh: 员工姓名，需与证件信息保持一致
fields.name: real_name

fields.help_en:
The English name of the employee. Specify the value in the following format:
Separate the last name and the first name with a forward slash (/). Example: LastName/FirstName.
Do not leave spaces between the last name and the first name
fields.help_zh:
员工的英文名。请按照以下格式要求进行传值：
英文姓氏与名字间用 "/" 分隔，如：LastName/FirstName。
姓氏与名字之间不要留有空格
fields.name: real_name_en

parameters.help_en: The identity document information of the employee
parameters.help_zh: 员工证件信息
parameters.name: cert_list

parameters.help_en: The collection of role IDs for the employee. The number of roles associated with a single employee must be less than or equal to 200. Otherwise, the employee synchronization will fail
parameters.help_zh: 员工的角色 ID 集合。同一员工关联的角色数要求小于等于 200 个，否则会导致员工同步不成功
parameters.name: custom_role_code_list

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the employee is an Alibaba Business Travel enterprise administrator
parameters.help_zh: 是否为阿里商旅企业管理员
parameters.name: is_admin

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the employee is a department manager
parameters.help_zh: 是否为部门主管
parameters.name: is_dept_leader

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the employee is the boss
parameters.help_zh: 是否为老板
parameters.name: is_boss

parameters.help_en:
The enterprise access credential.
When you call the API over HTTP, you must append this parameter to the request URL as a required parameter. For more information about how to obtain the credential, see Enterprise access credential (https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?docId=3769985).
You can append the parameter in the format of `so_corp_token=value`, `dtb_corp_token=value`, or `corp_token=value`. Use `corp_token=value`
parameters.help_zh:
企业访问凭证。
使用 HTTP 方式调用接口时需要作为必填参数拼接在请求地址中。获取方式请参见：企业访问凭证 (https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?docId=3769985)。
在拼接时，可以选择 `so_corp_token=value`、`dtb_corp_token=value` 以及 `corp_token=value` 任一写法，推荐使用 `corp_token=value`
parameters.name: x_acs_btrip_corp_token

parameters.help_en: The custom extension fields for the employee. Key-value pairs are supported
parameters.help_zh: 人员自定义扩展字段，支持填充 key&value
parameters.name: attribute

fields.help_en: The administrative division level. Valid values: province and city
fields.help_zh: 行政区划层级：省-province / 市-city
fields.name: level

parameters.help_en: The base location information of the employee
parameters.help_zh: 员工base地信息
parameters.name: base_location_list

parameters.help_en: The mobile phone number of the account. For enterprises that have enabled international mobile phone numbers, use the +xx-xxxxxx format for international numbers and numbers from Hong Kong (China), Macao (China), and Taiwan (China)
parameters.help_zh: 账号手机号。开通国际手机号的企业，传入的国际号码、中国香港、中国澳门和中国台湾地区号码，使用+xx-xxxxxx的格式
parameters.name: account_phone

parameters.help_en: The email address of the account. This parameter is available when the enterprise activation method is email activation
parameters.help_zh: 账号邮箱，企业激活方式为邮箱激活时可传入
parameters.name: account_email
